The [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.]] '''Leaper''' was a type of [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] that could carry a person and 25 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] and could go 30 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] vertically and 100 meters horizontally. It was sold by [[Galladinium Galactic Exports]].
